newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 278,800 MT were nearly double the previous week and 5 percent above the 4-week average.
The major increases were for South Korea (91,200 MT), Japan (75,700 MT), and Mexico (70,500 MT).

Exports of 206,900 MT were off one-half from the previous week and two-fifths from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (76,400 MT), South Korea (71,200 MT), and Mexico (51,000 MT).
